identification: Three books. Only item of interest: Ten Little Nigger Boys (Ten Little Nigger Boys and Girls) illustrated by Nora Case, Chatto & Windus, first issued 1907, reprinted in several editions c.1930s-1959. Edition in lot unknown. Kaplan Illustrated Manual of Sex Therapy and Complete Book of Sexual Love are common and worth little.

entries.note: 1952 Chatto & Windus reissue, fair condition. Snippet only, not verified. Rate assumed USD 1 = AUD 1.50.
Third edition c.1936, original pictorial boards, dealer calls it very scarce. Snippet only, not verified. Rate assumed GBP 1 = AUD 2.00.
Fourth edition c.1941, very good minus. Snippet only, currency unclear. Rate 1.50.
1959 copy, red illustrated cover, likely better condition. Snippet only. Rate 2.00.
